# Answer me with HTML

`am.mjs` is the generated CLI from [Answer me with HTML v0.5.10](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html/tree/f82dd6dce3ca95b0e565f8cffaf5eba23f4c995f). The local bundle changes the page credit to link to Code Review Lifecycle. The SHA-256 of the original upstream file is `5e08fda8e976927b16596624cf605e5aadd77828ee690a412b5a9a96584d4f2c`.

The skill calls this bundle through `scripts/render_html.mjs`. The wrapper disables the upstream update check. To update the renderer, replace the bundle and accompanying notices from a pinned upstream release, reapply the page credit in `colophon`, and rerun the rendering and installation checks.
